title: Why Does Bread Get Stale?
hook: Fresh bread holds water in a soft web of starch.
narration: Fresh bread holds water in a soft web of starch.
That water slowly leaves or rearranges.
The slice goes firm. That is stale, not always moldy.
A short toast can wake some softness back.
